constraints: Session is an owned live endpoint identity; sequence is monotonic and ledger checked before effects.
Clock identity/epoch must match the associated source; security deadlines use steady host time.
Exact immutable deployment-approved identity and digest; no URL, path, native symbol or arbitrary option bag.
Digest is exactly 32 SHA256 bytes of the immutable canonical registry descriptor.
Resolved name/type/role must match approved profile after remapping.

Node capability must independently authorize this exact owned node. Schema capabilities are ordered exactly like the immutable profile: topic 1, service request/response 2, action goal/feedback/result 3. No capability is opened or inferred from an alias or resource number.
Approved schema and encoding; recursively bounded decoder and content checks before effects.
Unavailable native fields remain absent; no fabricated receipt/ordering data.
Role-specific kind and schema; record committed only after complete checked copy.
State/effect use closed enums; reason sanitized and bounded. accepted is not remote completion.
An unknown physical outcome must not be treated as failed and automatically retried. Recovery requires qualified durable records or trusted device-state reconstruction.
Close, reconnect or restart must not erase outstanding effects, cleanup debt or safety latches; new provider generations reject old fencing.
Finite hard admission reservations with overflow-safe aggregation; separate from optional rates.
Cursor binds environment/filter/revision and expiry; bounded item count and cumulative bytes.
Provider profile selects ROS2 or ROS1 algebra, not their unrestricted union; recursion and all arrays bounded.
Floating nonfinite behavior must be explicitly declared by profile; no silent scalar conversion.
ROS1 integer range is provider XML-RPC int32; binary uses bytes, datetime uses explicitly validated XML-RPC lexical representation. Invalid XML-RPC value is not ROS2 not_set.
Resolved key must be granted; duplicate keys rejected in atomic requests.
Range kind must match the declared scalar parameter type; endpoint ordering checked before declaration.
Integer step preserves the native ROS uint64 domain independently of signed int64 values. Inclusive upper endpoint remains valid when not a step multiple.
Floating endpoints and step must be finite; step uses magnitude. Any comparison tolerance is fixed by trusted deployment profile, never guest supplied.
Only applicable numeric range kind; free-text additional constraints are not executable policy.
One bounded decision per input item; atomic result is all-or-none.
Revision precondition supported only when enforceable; remote absence is explicit.
Kinds validate/committed; validation cannot recursively mutate the pending transaction.
The local provider emits validate only for set. Committed events identify declare, undeclare or set explicitly; undeclare carries the deleted prior value and never substitutes not_set for deletion.
IDs belong to approved immutable transition graph.
Only permitted graph edges disclosed and submitted.
Absent stamp means provider-defined latest; absence and exact zero time are distinct.
All frames on query path must be permitted; fixed-frame semantics explicit.
Finite, typed units inherited from immutable schema.
Finite and normalized to profile tolerance; no silent correction beyond declared tolerance.
Exact frame authority; static replacement separately authorized.
Every frame/point/time window permitted; cache extent and averaging bound checked.
Rank/product/stride/offset checks precede allocation; approved dtype/layout; finite extent.
Reference is independently authorized, sealed when input, and pinned for entire request.
Immutable logical object; no native path or descriptor.
Digest is exactly 32 SHA256 bytes of the complete immutable object or bundle manifest.
Approved bundle member role; all members share admitted transaction; no relative traversal.
Complete purpose validator and atomic generation switch; publication and durability distinguished.
Messages use immutable QoS schema; unknown effective fields absent; no silent downgrade.
UUID exactly 16 bytes; protocol duplicate handling; UUID confers no ownership.
Closed transition set; exact transition action and goal ownership independently checked.
Source-field visibility and bounded retention; poll consumes complete record only.
Trusted provenance from host registry; guest-created input marked untrusted origin.
Trusted host metadata includes steady capture time, source incarnation, sample sequence and calibration/transform generations; model bytes cannot assign it.
Tool policy explicitly selects latest-required or bounded-age observations and defines units, missing/unknown estimates, uncertainty, clock provenance and frame relationships.

Canonical proposal records and actual sealed-buffer leases are core-qualified. Trusted incarnation, sample and authority metadata remain host-owned; physical targets and deployment-specific native ROS sensor schemas are not implied.
Model/profile pinned; horizon/branches/tokens/spend bound by task schema and provider capacity.
Proposal is inert data; accepting arbiter and current target grants are separate.
Tool profile fixes effect class, physical scope, exact target/action and schema; a model producer cannot acquire arbiter or target authority.
Acceptance creates only an inert historical receipt. Actual execution requires current target authorization and fencing at its atomic effect-admission point.
Transport identifiers plus physical bounds, freshness, frame/units and watchdog contract enforced.
Immutable target profile classifies physical effects and binds physical resource scope, including commands routed through topics, services, actions, parameters and lifecycle operations.

Execution admission atomically rechecks current authority, owner/priority lease, controller fencing, provider boot generation, command limits, observations and steady expiry; enqueue-only checking is insufficient.
Independent stop/watchdog reservations cannot be exhausted by normal requests, inference, optional attenuation or unknown-outcome records; rearm is trusted deployment management.
Controller capability is independently authorized; the command cannot supply a principal, priority, renewed lease, permission epoch or trusted stopped witness.
The selected operation profile fixes the effect class, target set, complete value validator and required dependencies; no raw bus/native opcode fallback exists.
Robot-provider observations and dependencies are strictly increasing by (capability, resource), with no duplicates; both lists share the whole-request element budget.
Sample/update/write phases carry same owned sequence; no implicit skipped command.
The original bounded input pins and version dependencies survive through submit/effect completion; failed delivery cannot advance the sample sequence.
Robot-provider observations and dependencies use the same canonical increasing reference order as command; both lists share one element budget.
Bind every required slot exactly once before publishing the inert bridge handle. Each endpoint is independently owned and authorized.

The immutable graph fixes bounded correlations, feedback/cancellation directions, QoS loss mapping, loop suppression and shutdown policy. Bridging cannot remove a source effect classification or destination safety predicate.
Bindings are strictly increasing by nonzero slot; duplicate or undeclared roles reject the whole graph. There is no fixed 64-slot registry ceiling.
Observe/export source authority independent of store write; bound total physical workflow envelope.
Reading neither publishes nor drives a clock without independent grant.

Exact immutable executable/plugin/dependency closure and configuration object authenticated by its separate artifact capability. No guest argv, environment, filesystem path, native symbol or loader option.

Child messages select only manifest-declared role indices. The supervisor authenticates the originating worker generation and rechecks the complete parent authority before each effect; child bytes cannot mint capabilities.

Bindings are strictly increasing by nonzero slot; each is checked against the exact manifest role and independent caller origin. Empty bindings are allowed only when the manifest declares no external roles.
Existing local wait ABI encodes contiguous four-word records without a length prefix; required output bytes supplies count.
Exact observation authority on referenced source; no payload/buffer assumption.
uwvm/action/Event scene-canonical body; outer delivery correlation is the request token, never the goal handle. UUID exactly 16 bytes and grants no authority.
State is closed: pending 0, accepted 1, executing 2, cancelling 3, succeeded 4, cancelled 5, aborted 6, rejected 7. Proposal/feedback/result payload retains its approved schema.
uwvm/action/CancelResponse scene-canonical body; actual ROS return code 0 accepted, 1 rejected, 2 unknown goal, 3 terminated goal. Cancellation acceptance is not terminal execution.
Only an owned goal; native service request headers remain private. A latest cancel token does not replace retained independent correlations.
uwvm/action/State scene-canonical body. Retired uncertain scopes cannot be reopened or replaced without qualified reconciliation.
Sanitized endpoint description; never discloses originating capability handles. Resource identity is not authority.
Native identity is bounded and optional, copied only from the actual same retained endpoint. Reconnect never reuses an old incarnation; no guessed or all-zero fabricated GID.
Provider incarnation is optional and comes from the retained provider; a host grant generation or configured profile is not substitute evidence. Unknown is absent, never numeric zero.
Guest-asserted event time only; nonzero clock identity is a label, not authority or a security deadline.
Bounded literal guest-asserted source location; never a host path to open.
Six LE u64 words. Scope is broker-owned. Exact last request replay returns identical local volatile acceptance; explicit queue loss is preserved.
Closed deployed local-log schema codes 1..11. Unavailable rows have value zero and saturated false; no payloads or names.
Immutable bounded snapshot with host-steady finite lifetime. Failed delivery retains the exact page; next cursor acknowledges earlier pages. Debug inspection does not expire or capture.
Actual typed source and independently admitted sealed buffer capability; no guest-provided provenance.
Ordered actual sealed input references retained by the capture.
Distinct creation request, never an endpoint handle. Closed state/status/effect enum mapping is defined by communication_open_contract.h; no unknown numeric tags.
Unknown native effects and unconfirmed cleanup retain debt; they cannot be released as known failures.
At most 63 entries; channel 1..65535, sequence 0..UINT32_MAX, SHA exactly 32 bytes. Actual pinned buffer layout/profile/size/SHA must match trusted channel; timestamps are metadata, not provenance.
Exact caller-owned volatile complete MCAP object; SHA exactly 32 bytes. Zero object fields denote no new checkpoint in a mutation receipt.
Fixed 104 bytes. Tags append=1, checkpoint=2, drain=3, abort=4. Exact accepted request replay never repeats the effect or charges again; receipt is not durability.
Complete original ROS serialized bytes; no native publish, time advance or physical command.
Closed body of sensor.describe state message: type ros.sensor.state, encoding le64. Cached metadata only; no credentials or native descriptor.
Nonzero broker-issued sequence and independent nonce bind one endpoint, consumer, provider incarnation and retained original record. Guest memory never owns native storage.
Reserve copies one immutable record without consuming it. Complete output preflight precedes reservation publication. Invalid/short/failed output leaves the record available.
Acknowledge consumes only the matching live reservation; release retains the original record. Timeout/revoke/provider loss has an explicit recorded outcome, never implicit acknowledgement.
Finite retained bytes/items/reservation slots and reply/retry capacity are reserved before native borrow. Stop/cancel and cleanup capacity is separate from traffic attenuation.
All fields must match the original reservation, exact consumer and admitted endpoint; no guessed or recyclable native IDs.
Nonempty, unique handles of goals owned by the exact opened client endpoint. At most min(64, immutable max_goals) candidates.
No native UUID, time selector, omitted goal, foreign principal or implicit wildcard. Broader native selection requires separate authenticated-principal support, which is not currently admitted.

All handles are checked before the first effect. Per-candidate native admission may differ; cancellation is not a remote atomic transaction. Exact retry returns retained results without reissuing any candidate.
Only closed catalogue operations relevant to this admitted binding; no unrelated hidden endpoint or credential disclosure.
A declared configuration is not native support. Failure, unsupported introspection and stale provider generation report unknown/unavailable.
Exact role-specific native endpoint leg; client/service request and response QoS are independently reported and never copied from each other.
Request zero and effect zero mean no native effect. Effect values are none=0, locally_accepted=1, observed_remote=2, unknown=3.
Native admission is not server cancellation acceptance, terminal task completion or physical safe-state confirmation.
Both nonzero; resolve under the current host-authenticated caller, exact purpose, owner and generation. Numbers confer no authority.
Current approved immutable revision from the actual source registry; revalidate at external-effect admission. Guest assertions cannot establish activation.
An existing owned control session and its expected fencing epoch; receiver also checks the host-minted lease, provider generation and steady expiry.

Availability/arming are trusted provider evidence, not inferred from a deadline field. A mandatory unavailable watchdog refuses activation. A stop reservation is internal audit identity, not a handle granting stop authority.
Armed implies available. Positive finite maximum_silence_ns uses host steady time. Stop reservation and provider generation are nonzero audit identities.
Absent evidence remains absent. A transport acknowledgement cannot be encoded as independently observed stopped equipment.

An asserted observation includes at least one independently authorized source; outcome_unresolved may have none. Its provider generation must match the corresponding command receipt. Neither this syntax check nor a matching generation authenticates physical evidence.
Only sanitized declared support and cached actual state. Describing never starts hardware, polls a bus, clears a latch, renews ownership or reveals native descriptors.
Finite reservations are not UINT64_MAX sentinels. Retained unknown commands remain included in maximum pending capacity. Ready requires actual available and armed independent watchdog evidence.
Publish only after local ownership preparation and complete copy; rollback failed publication. Remote effect requires separately confirmed current receiver fencing.

Checked arithmetic: nonempty planes require stride >= row_bytes and offset+(rows-1)*stride+row_bytes <= actual sealed buffer length. Zero dimensions have explicit profile semantics; overlapping planes require a codec-specific reviewed profile.

Immutable codec profile fixes encoding, color/chroma/endianness, audio sample format/rate, supported dimensions and conversion. Header dimensions never override decoded expansion limits. Encoded packets require their own parser and do not masquerade as raw planes.

Raw planes have positive row bytes and rows, stride at least row bytes, overflow-checked disjoint bounding extents in increasing offset order. image requires positive width/height/channels and zero samples; audio requires zero width/height and positive channels/samples. encoded_packet has no raw planes; expansion is checked by its codec profile.
Deliver one complete sealed output under the explicitly supplied output capability. Failed copy leaves the same item and identity reserved. Source time, receive time, sequence and loss stay distinct.

Unique nonzero slot in the immutable approved flow graph. The slot fixes ROS generation, direction, schema, conversion, QoS and operation tags; no guest-selected topic name, native address or converter.
Read sanitized cached counters and last receipt only. Running does not mean all prior forwards completed; unknown correlations retain capacity until qualified reconciliation.
Pending includes retained unresolved effects; unknown cannot exceed pending. A last receipt can belong to a retired provider generation and is not rewritten after restart.
Unique nonzero manifest role. The role fixes exact allowed operations, schemas, effect class and independent budget; no ambient delegation or module-wide wildcard grant.
Cached sanitized lifecycle/resource evidence, never PIDs, secrets, native paths or model payload. Exit observation is not proof of device safe state.

Pending includes retained unresolved effects. Observed complete process-tree exit requires zero live processes; exited requires exit_observed. Retained bytes and unresolved records may remain after exit.

First failure is a monotonic per-incarnation host observation: 0 none, 1 admission refused, 2 launch failed, 3 startup protocol, 4 channel failed, 5 protocol violation, 6 deadline elapsed, 7 authority lost, 8 diagnostic limit, 9 backend reported failure. Stop, reaping and read-only queries never clear or replace it. Failed requires a nonzero code; a retained code is allowed only in failed, retired or outcome_unknown state. This is not native signal attribution or durable recovery evidence.
Strictly increasing positive deployment slots. Source and buffer capabilities must already be explicitly opened by the caller. No implicit capability creation or alias-based authority.
Metadata only: no host paths, payloads, credentials, addresses, or transferable authority.
At most 32 rows per page, 65536 scanned rows and 65536 response bytes; absent compiled family returns unsupported and supported=false. Built disabled families report enabled=false.

operations.name: abi
operations.contract: Returns major 2 only when explicitly exposed; errors encoded in same i32 result.

operations.name: capability.open
operations.contract: Exact existing alias; no grant creation or upgrade; undelivered handle rolled back.

operations.name: capability.close
operations.contract: Close capability handle without resetting budgets or resource lifetime.

operations.name: guard.create
operations.contract: Create owned guard, rollback if handle delivery fails.

operations.name: guard.trigger
operations.contract: Increment guard generation under exact owner grant.

operations.name: guard.take
operations.contract: Consume pending count only after checked delivery.

operations.name: clock.create
operations.contract: Kind must match exact clock purpose.

operations.name: clock.read
operations.contract: Sample owned clock; unstarted time remains flagged.

operations.name: clock.update
operations.contract: ROS clock source must independently permit clock.read with matching resource and binding.

operations.name: timer.create
operations.contract: Clock dependency needs independent read grant.

operations.name: timer.reset
operations.contract: Overflow-checked schedule; zero period is one-shot.

operations.name: timer.cancel
operations.contract: Disarm owned timer and notify waiters.

operations.name: timer.take
operations.contract: Coalesced occurrence record consumed only after delivery.

operations.name: wait.create
operations.contract: Create empty owned waitset.

operations.name: wait.add
operations.contract: Source requires independent resource.observe; bounded membership.

operations.name: wait.remove
operations.contract: Detach exact source from owned waitset.

operations.name: wait.acknowledge
operations.contract: Acknowledge source sequence; readiness is not data consumption.

operations.name: wait.poll
operations.contract: Nonconsuming bounded readiness; infinite wait explicit; authority revalidated after wake.

operations.name: resource.close
operations.contract: Close an owned local scheduling, lifecycle, sealed-buffer, model or transform resource according to its cleanup contract. Retained borrows or cleanup debt retain their capacity until actual retirement; closure does not grant another purpose. Sensor/proposal and recording/replay handles route to their owning dispatchers; retained borrows/pins still prevent premature retirement.

operations.name: context.open
operations.contract: Create an independently owned context only after complete provider/security closure validation.

operations.name: context.describe
operations.contract: Sanitized context identity, supported features and shutdown state. Provider feature reporting distinguishes configured, native-attested supported and currently available states; missing/failed native feature probes are not affirmative support.

operations.name: context.shutdown
operations.contract: Cancel owned work and wake waits; never process exit.

operations.name: node.open
operations.contract: Resolve immutable node/name/remapping/profile under exact parent context grant. Creation is asynchronous: explicit monotonically increasing key and finite absolute steady deadline; response is a request receipt, not an endpoint. communication.open.take retrieves a separately published typed handle.

operations.name: node.describe
operations.contract: Only owned resolved identity and enabled features.

operations.name: type.describe
operations.contract: Bounded immutable approved schema dependency closure; type names never load code.

operations.name: topic.open
operations.contract: Create exactly one publisher or subscription role. Creation is asynchronous: explicit monotonically increasing key and finite absolute steady deadline; response is a request receipt, not an endpoint. communication.open.take retrieves a separately published typed handle.

operations.name: topic.publish
operations.contract: Reserve and validate complete message before acceptance; acceptance is not remote delivery.

operations.name: topic.take
operations.contract: Receive one source record without consuming on invalid/short output.

operations.name: topic.describe
operations.contract: Owned node, resolved endpoint/type/direction and profile, with optional cached actual provider incarnation and native identity. Metadata is copied from the same retained endpoint; no middleware call or discovery occurs during description. Unknown provider generation and GID remain absent. This grants no publication or subscription authority.

operations.name: qos.describe
operations.contract: Requested/effective/supported settings; unavailable values remain absent.

operations.name: qos.liveliness.assert
operations.contract: Only publisher role and qualified native manual-liveliness support.

operations.name: qos.acknowledgements.wait
operations.contract: Wait for defined native acknowledgement horizon; unsupported is not success.

operations.name: service.open
operations.contract: Fix client/server role and finite request/response capacities. Creation is asynchronous: explicit monotonically increasing key and finite absolute steady deadline; response is a request receipt, not an endpoint. communication.open.take retrieves a separately published typed handle.

operations.name: service.submit
operations.contract: Owned native-correlated request; remote outcome can remain unknown after timeout.

operations.name: service.take
operations.contract: Role-specific request/response atomically delivered with correlation.

operations.name: service.respond
operations.contract: Respond once to an exact live owned received request.

operations.name: service.available
operations.contract: Observation is not a promise for the next request.

operations.name: service.abandon
operations.contract: Retire local wait/response interest; never claim remote cancellation.

operations.name: action.open
operations.contract: Fix action role, goal/feedback/result types and retention. Creation is asynchronous: explicit monotonically increasing key and finite absolute steady deadline; response is a request receipt, not an endpoint. communication.open.take retrieves a separately published typed handle.

operations.name: action.submit
operations.contract: Goal UUID is correlated with owned goal resource; not a transferable authority token.

operations.name: action.take
operations.contract: Goal proposal/status/feedback/result/cancel request are distinct closed event kinds. uwvm/action/Event body follows action_event; outer correlation is request, body goal/UUID remain distinct.

operations.name: action.respond
operations.contract: Legal transition and exact secondary action checked; accepted cancel is not terminal.

operations.name: action.cancel
operations.contract: Cancellation proposal for owned goal; broader cancel set requires separate explicit scope.

operations.name: action.describe
operations.contract: Sanitized endpoint/owned-goal state and retention; no unrelated UUID discovery. uwvm/action/State body follows action_endpoint_state.

operations.name: parameter.open
operations.contract: Bind exact parameter keys, value algebra, descriptors and role.

operations.name: parameter.declare
operations.contract: Declaration respects override/dynamic/read-only policy without ambient YAML access.

operations.name: parameter.undeclare
operations.contract: Explicit deletion distinct from not-set/uninitialized value.

operations.name: parameter.get
operations.contract: Bounded batch; missing/uninitialized/denied are not silently conflated.

operations.name: parameter.describe
operations.contract: Only granted descriptor metadata.

operations.name: parameter.list
operations.contract: Bounded filtered key listing; counts and cursors obey same visibility. Name entries use fixed message type_identity ros.parameter.name and encoding canonical.text; each body is exactly one canonical wire text.

operations.name: parameter.set
operations.contract: Per-item writes; report every committed/rejected/unknown decision.

operations.name: parameter.set.atomic
operations.contract: All or none only within qualified provider atomic domain; do not fake cross-node CAS. A ROS1 provider must separately declare atomic upsert of permitted undeclared keys and subtree replacement semantics; ROS2 declaration rules remain distinct. Native bridging cannot silently emulate atomic upsert with a racy get/declare/set sequence.

operations.name: parameter.take
operations.contract: Deliver validation or committed event; no native callback into guest.

operations.name: parameter.respond
operations.contract: Current validator generation/deadline; transformed keys and values revalidated; no recursive mutation.

operations.name: lifecycle.open
operations.contract: Open one explicitly permitted client=1/server=2 role in a deployed local-lifecycle alias; no native node or actuator authority. Opening never resets state or history.

operations.name: lifecycle.state
operations.contract: Observe owned cached logical state and enforce an expired finite deadline on access; no physical or autonomous stop guarantee.

operations.name: lifecycle.transitions
operations.contract: Return only currently legal and deployment-permitted transition bits; no transition authority is granted.

operations.name: lifecycle.submit
operations.contract: Exactly ordered successful-submission keys with original receipt replay, finite absolute steady deadline, expected generation and one pending callback. Rejected submissions do not consume key.

operations.name: lifecycle.take
operations.contract: Reserve one callback, release provider lock before checked delivery, then revalidate owner/request/generation/deadline before marking delivered. Failed delivery is not consumed.

operations.name: lifecycle.respond
operations.contract: Resolve only an exactly delivered matching request/generation using ROS outcome97/98/99. Preserve last exact response receipt; error queues error-processing callback. No native callback execution.

operations.name: transform.open
operations.contract: Bound frame set/cache/source/clock-epoch policy.

operations.name: transform.publish
operations.contract: Authorize every parent/child and source; nonzero expected_generation fences the whole batch. Actual static replacement requires a matching nonzero generation and exact transform.static.replace action; zero permits only additions or unchanged static replay.

operations.name: transform.lookup
operations.contract: Enforce all query-path frames, epochs and cache bounds.

operations.name: transform.available
operations.contract: Same visibility boundary as lookup; no hidden frame existence leak.

operations.name: transform.velocity
operations.contract: Advanced time/reference-point operation with all frame/window checks.

operations.name: transform.submit
operations.contract: Owned asynchronous wait binds exact clock epoch and query.

operations.name: transform.take
operations.contract: Nonconsuming failed copy of one owned query result.

operations.name: transform.cancel
operations.contract: Cancel owned query and wake waiters.

operations.name: transform.clear
operations.contract: Explicit history mutation and pending query invalidation; static policy separate.

operations.name: graph.snapshot
operations.contract: Exact filtered discovery through an explicitly owned observer node and context; observer node profile and actual parent context must match, with counted attachment capacity and complete origin authority.

operations.name: graph.watch
operations.contract: Exact filtered discovery through an explicitly owned observer node and context; observer node profile and actual parent context must match, with counted attachment capacity and complete origin authority.

operations.name: event.stream.open
operations.contract: Authorize each observed source and field policy; source references use capability/resource pair.

operations.name: event.stream.poll
operations.contract: Copy complete records before consumption; explicit loss and generation; bounded steady deadline.

operations.name: event.stream.close
operations.contract: Detach exact stream and wake waiters without closing sources.

operations.name: buffer.create
operations.contract: Reserve bounded data/workspace before publication.

operations.name: buffer.write
operations.contract: Contiguous bounded write only before seal; no native pointer.

operations.name: buffer.seal
operations.contract: Immutable publication with digest and registered layout.

operations.name: buffer.read
operations.contract: Exact bounded read; no host descriptor export.

operations.name: buffer.describe
operations.contract: Untrusted origin cannot be relabelled as a trusted sensor.

operations.name: artifact.open
operations.contract: Exact positive deployment generation and 32 raw SHA256 bytes; sealed-input binding only. Roll back unpublished handles on failed delivery. No output-store read binding.

operations.name: artifact.read
operations.contract: Bounded requested bytes from immutable handle and offset; raw output, EOF short read, no cursor. Exact read action; requested bytes cannot exceed configured transfer or output capacity. Published volatile cache objects are also readable under independent cache read authority; staging stays hidden.

operations.name: artifact.describe
operations.contract: 64-byte approved metadata: four LE words then raw32 SHA256. Purpose codes1 package,2 configuration,3 calibration,4 map,5 model-weights. No source path or FD.

operations.name: artifact.begin
operations.contract: Explicit cache/volatile-output only. Per-alias next-key ACK and exact last-request replay; full begin allocation remains charged until abort/remove. Publication is immutable session data, never durable. Status and receipt queries do not acknowledge. No host path or descriptor.

operations.name: artifact.append
operations.contract: Explicit cache/volatile-output only. Per-alias next-key ACK and exact last-request replay; full begin allocation remains charged until abort/remove. Publication is immutable session data, never durable. Status and receipt queries do not acknowledge. No host path or descriptor.

operations.name: artifact.commit
operations.contract: Explicit cache/volatile-output only. Per-alias next-key ACK and exact last-request replay; full begin allocation remains charged until abort/remove. Publication is immutable session data, never durable. Status and receipt queries do not acknowledge. No host path or descriptor.

operations.name: artifact.abort
operations.contract: Explicit cache/volatile-output only. Per-alias next-key ACK and exact last-request replay; full begin allocation remains charged until abort/remove. Publication is immutable session data, never durable. Status and receipt queries do not acknowledge. No host path or descriptor.

operations.name: artifact.remove
operations.contract: Explicit cache/volatile-output only. Per-alias next-key ACK and exact last-request replay; full begin allocation remains charged until abort/remove. Publication is immutable session data, never durable. Status and receipt queries do not acknowledge. No host path or descriptor.

operations.name: sensor.open
operations.contract: Ingress-only approved source/transport/schema/queue; no send/listen authority.

operations.name: sensor.take
operations.contract: Validated complete frame with timestamp origin and discontinuity. Capacity for the largest complete frame is checked before native read. The local capture ordinal and optional actual native sequence are distinct. Failed guest copy retains the frame for retry.

operations.name: sensor.describe
operations.contract: Bound source identity, loss and negotiated capabilities; no credentials.

operations.name: device.open
operations.contract: Approved bus/protocol/command envelope, independent watchdog and finite capacity.

operations.name: device.submit
operations.contract: Full command bounds/freshness/units/frame before hardware effect.

operations.name: device.result
operations.contract: Distinguish accepted, observed execution, partial and unknown effect.

operations.name: device.stop
operations.contract: Requires explicit stop authority; trusted watchdog independent.

operations.name: device.describe
operations.contract: Actual provider/firmware support, state and watchdog contract.

operations.name: control.open
operations.contract: Reserve complete continuous cycle and safe-state contract.

operations.name: control.sample
operations.contract: A bounded input/read phase tied to write deadline and sequence.

operations.name: control.submit
operations.contract: Check same cycle/sequence/deadline; no attenuation skips an admitted phase.

operations.name: control.result
operations.contract: Report actual execution, missed phase and watchdog outcome.

operations.name: control.stop
operations.contract: Drain or qualified safe stop; revoke never disables watchdog.

operations.name: media.open
operations.contract: Separate codec/ingress/egress/viewer and listener profile grants.

operations.name: media.submit
operations.contract: Bound decoded expansion, encoded output and egress destination.

operations.name: media.take
operations.contract: Complete bounded encoded/decoded frame under profile.

operations.name: media.close
operations.contract: Only owned stream/viewer; no unrelated listener shutdown.

operations.name: recording.open
operations.contract: Private finite volatile MCAP store with exact deployment channel/buffer profiles, caller incarnation ownership, atomic source read/export authority and retained pinned objects. Writer mutations use next-key exact recovery; resource.close releases writer or an unpinned checkpoint. Checkpoint is complete volatile acceptance, not durable storage.

operations.name: recording.append
operations.contract: Private finite volatile MCAP store with exact deployment channel/buffer profiles, caller incarnation ownership, atomic source read/export authority and retained pinned objects. Writer mutations use next-key exact recovery; resource.close releases writer or an unpinned checkpoint. Checkpoint is complete volatile acceptance, not durable storage.

operations.name: recording.checkpoint
operations.contract: Private finite volatile MCAP store with exact deployment channel/buffer profiles, caller incarnation ownership, atomic source read/export authority and retained pinned objects. Writer mutations use next-key exact recovery; resource.close releases writer or an unpinned checkpoint. Checkpoint is complete volatile acceptance, not durable storage.

operations.name: recording.stop
operations.contract: Private finite volatile MCAP store with exact deployment channel/buffer profiles, caller incarnation ownership, atomic source read/export authority and retained pinned objects. Writer mutations use next-key exact recovery; resource.close releases writer or an unpinned checkpoint. Checkpoint is complete volatile acceptance, not durable storage.

operations.name: replay.open
operations.contract: Private finite volatile MCAP store with exact deployment channel/buffer profiles, caller incarnation ownership, atomic source read/export authority and retained pinned objects. Replay uses an explicitly granted fixed source and exact object digests; it returns bytes only and never publishes or changes clocks.

operations.name: replay.read
operations.contract: Private finite volatile MCAP store with exact deployment channel/buffer profiles, caller incarnation ownership, atomic source read/export authority and retained pinned objects. Replay uses an explicitly granted fixed source and exact object digests; it returns bytes only and never publishes or changes clocks.

operations.name: replay.seek
operations.contract: Private finite volatile MCAP store with exact deployment channel/buffer profiles, caller incarnation ownership, atomic source read/export authority and retained pinned objects. Replay uses an explicitly granted fixed source and exact object digests; it returns bytes only and never publishes or changes clocks.

operations.name: model.open

operations.name: capability.revoke
operations.contract: Permanently revoke exactly the carrier capability grant. The target must equal the carrier capability, the exact grant must contain capability.revoke and the import must be exposed. One pre-reserved receipt per grant retains the nonzero retry key, exact caller incarnation and target. Atomically fence admissions before nonblocking provider retirement notifications. Retirement state 1 means fenced with notification pending; 2 means local notifications returned, never proof of native process exit, remote cancellation or physical stop. Exact retry can recover failed output after revocation without repeating notifications or allocating. Closing the handle or retiring the caller removes recovery access. No traffic quota may prevent this independently authorized authority reduction; short output and cancellation reject before fencing. Reopening cannot restore the grant; only trusted deployment creates new authority.

operations.name: topic.reserve
operations.contract: Explicit two-phase receive: independently authorize the exact consumer endpoint, retain the original native record and deliver a bounded detached copy without acknowledgement. Same-consumer retry returns the retained record/nonce; concurrent consumers cannot steal it. Both node/context/schema origins and native metadata remain attached.

operations.name: topic.acknowledge
operations.contract: Consume exactly the previously reserved record after guest processing. Exact replay is idempotent; stale generation, wrong consumer, altered nonce or expired reservation is refused. Lost native ACK is outcome_unknown and never triggers blind re-consumption. Bounded receipt survives failed guest delivery.

operations.name: topic.release
operations.contract: Cancel exactly the owned borrow while retaining the original record. This is not service-request cancellation or endpoint close. Cleanup uses pre-reserved capacity and is not throttled by creation/traffic quotas; uncertain native cancellation retains debt until trusted reconciliation.

operations.name: parameter.search

One coherent local store snapshot supplies a revision even for negative results. No ambient namespace, filesystem path or unrestricted discovery. This local provider does not impersonate a native parameter server.

WASI descriptor rows are initial approved rights; ROSv1 rows are configured policy, not a complete live handle snapshot. Carrier capability must be zero. Exact immediate caller identity comes from the runtime. Observation never freezes deployment, enrolls a caller, opens a capability, replenishes or consumes execution quotas, starts a provider, invokes an export, reads foreign memory, or changes another policy. A denial writes neither result nor length. Owned temporary buffers are securely overwritten.

operations.name: module.call.submit

Failed delivery discards the unpublished request. Trusted startup route fixes exact endpoint names, semantic operation, opaque schema identities, finite byte/slot/reservation/deadline ceilings. No arbitrary export invocation. Inputs and registered delivery regions must use owned, unexported shared memory; imported memory, exported memory, nonshared heaps, active threaded host calls and resumable/replay compilation profiles are refused. A live debugger value-observation profile is allowed; it does not grant recording, restoration or message authority. Detached scene queries never copy payloads; separately authorized debugger memory reads remain subject to debugger disclosure policy. Input carrier is copied with byte atomics and zeroed before dispatch by default. Trusted startup bool clear_after_copy defaults to true; false retains sender input bytes, including failure cleanup, without weakening authorization, bounds, tags or broker/delivery erasure. Guest requests cannot change this frozen per-route policy. Retained spans cannot overlap across outstanding calls/routes. Full buffer capacity is overwritten on consume, response, acknowledge, cancel, observed expiry, revoke and retirement. Failed erasure quarantines the slot. Expiry is lazy, not a hard timer; independent guest copies are outside this erasure contract.

operations.name: driver.connect
operations.contract: Perform one nonblocking handshake on a registered inherited channel. Readiness grants no actuation authority; repeated handshake polling never launches code.

operations.name: driver.submit
operations.contract: Submit one bounded fixed-contract request. Exact in-flight retry returns its receipt without resending. Changed bytes or deadline conflict; submission is local transport acceptance, never physical completion.

operations.name: driver.result
operations.contract: Receive an exact sequence and incarnation-bound result. Failed guest delivery retains bytes. Timeout after send fences the session with effect_unknown; never retry a non-idempotent operation automatically.

operations.name: driver.describe
operations.contract: Read detached session metadata only; never pump packets, infer physical safety, restart a driver or replenish authority.

operations.name: driver.disconnect
operations.contract: Release this connection and erase retained buffers. Best-effort release and local descriptor closure never terminate a shared driver. Independent receiver expiry remains mandatory.
